limitations: Supporting geometric contrast observations, not human perception or linear-light photometry. A patch assumes the declared solid eight-cell bar around the native-witnessed centre. Whole native hashes are bound by the verified report. Overview sampling can underresolve individual cells. Water, Sand and transparent Play content are excluded from opaque material-colour preservation claims. Two exact patches do not prove every physical material pixel is unchanged.
method: Exact original PNG decode; projected source-cell centres; mean nine-pixel patches at actual native-verified material58 positions in Play platform, Play ground and rear false platform. Local rear edge uses native y207/y221. Encoded-sRGB coefficients(.2126,.7152,.0722); mean adjacent horizontal pixel contrast in the declared rear-only high-frequency region. No image resampling, generation or edits.
